title: Enemy Pie
author: Derek Munson
intro: It was going to be the perfect summer. Then Jeremy Ross moved into the house down the street.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: Who moves into the house down the street?
questions.yes: Jeremy Ross moved into the house down the street.

questions.q: What does the boy call Jeremy Ross?
questions.clue: Jeremy is the only name on his enemy list.
questions.yes: Jeremy Ross became the boy's number one enemy.

questions.q: Why does the boy dislike Jeremy at first?

options.text: Jeremy laughed at him at baseball
Jeremy took his favourite football away

questions.clue: It happened during a game with a bat and ball.
questions.yes: Jeremy laughed at him when he struck out at baseball.

questions.q: What kind of party does Jeremy have?
questions.clue: You bounce up and down on one.

questions.q: Who does Jeremy invite instead of the boy?
questions.clue: It is the boy's best friend.
questions.yes: Jeremy invited the boy's best friend, Stanley, but not the boy.

questions.q: Who has a secret recipe for getting rid of enemies?
questions.clue: He had enemies when he was a boy too.
questions.yes: Dad has a secret recipe for Enemy Pie.

questions.q: What must the boy do for the pie to work?

options.text: Stay in his bedroom all day

questions.clue: He has to play with his enemy.
questions.yes: He had to spend a whole day playing with Jeremy.

questions.q: How does the Enemy Pie smell?
questions.clue: The boy is surprised it smells this way.
questions.yes: The Enemy Pie smelled really good.

questions.q: How does Jeremy look when the boy asks him to play?
questions.clue: He does not understand why his enemy wants to play.
questions.yes: Jeremy looked confused when the boy asked him to play.

questions.q: What do the boys throw at the girls?
questions.clue: They are full of water and they splash.
questions.yes: The boys threw water balloons at the girls.

questions.q: Where do the boys hide out?
questions.clue: It is a little house up in a tree.
questions.yes: The boys hid out in the treehouse.

questions.q: Which sport do the boys play together?
questions.clue: You throw the ball through a hoop.

questions.q: What does the boy try to do at dinner?
questions.clue: He doesn't want Jeremy to eat it any more.
questions.yes: The boy tried to stop Jeremy eating the Enemy Pie.

questions.q: Why does the boy want to save Jeremy from the pie?

options.text: He wants to eat it all himself

questions.clue: They had lots of fun together all day.
questions.yes: Jeremy wasn't his enemy any more. He was his friend.

questions.q: What does Jeremy invite the boy to do next morning?
questions.clue: It is what Jeremy had at his party.
questions.yes: Jeremy invited the boy to play on his trampoline.
